criteria.evidence: everyPoseHasSpec checks values for 3 poses; the other 8 rely on hero_paige_* baselines (assertNotNull on a non-null spec is vacuous).

reducedClockStaysZero fails if the loop runs under reduced; reducedHasZeroTimeTransformAtAllTimes only calls the pure functions with the Reduced token set (amplitudes 0), not TmrPaige's graphicsLayer.
translationYIs5dpAtQuarterPeriod asserts 5 dp from paigeTranslationYDp; fails if amplitude or period changes. graphicsLayer-only use is not asserted but is visible in code.

paigeIsNotATalkBackStop fails if a contentDescription or focusable is added; it would not fail if clearAndSetSemantics were removed, since a bare Canvas has no semantics. Adequate guard for the stated regressions.
headlineTwoLines fails if maxLines=2 is removed (long headline at 300 dp) or font sizes change; radius, padding and colour covered by hero_card_* baselines.
disabledTapRunsOnDisabledClickOnly and disabledReportsButtonWithStateDescription can fail; fill #222222 is only screenshot-covered.
enabledColoursAndMinHeight asserts label colour and 56 dp min height; lime fill and font 2.0 clipping are screenshot-covered.
Screenshot-only by design; not in my review scope.
Role.RadioButton and Selected asserted for both states and click; colours via baselines.
Role.Switch, ToggleableState and callback asserted; toggleable passes the new value natively.
Label as accessible name and readOnly (SetText absent) asserted; amber, fill and TextArea/LabeledField covered by baselines only.
PR body reports verify-local.sh pass; not re-run by me.

findings.rule: 266-c2 / issue AC: a test asserts that under reduced Paige's offset is 0 at any frame time
findings.trigger: If TmrPaige's graphicsLayer were changed to call paigeTranslationYDp(TmrMotionDefaults.Default, ...) or read the motion from elsewhere, so Paige bobs under reduced motion, every test still passes: this test only calls the pure functions with the Reduced token set, and the clock test only covers rememberPaigeTimeMs.
findings.title: Reduced-motion test never measures the composable
findings.proof: Render TmrPaige(Tailoring) under LocalTmrMotion=Reduced with mainClock advanced, and assert the graphicsLayer translationY and rotationZ stay at the static pose values; the test fails if the graphicsLayer used non-reduced motion.

findings.trigger: assertNotNull on pose.spec(), a non-null Kotlin return, always passes, so a wrong spec for any of the 8 poses without value assertions (e.g. Upload eyeWidth) is not caught by this test.
findings.title: everyPoseHasSpec is vacuous for 8 of 11 poses

findings.trigger: Changing the disabled fill from #222222 or the enabled fill from lime changes no assertion; only the label colour and height are checked, so the fill relies on the baselines alone.
findings.title: Button fill colours are not asserted outside screenshots
